description: The Eldritch Knight blends martial prowess with arcane magic.

features.name: Spellcasting
features.description: Learn Wizard spells. Cantrips: 2. Spells prepared scale with level. Cast with Strength/Dexterity modifier.

features.name: Weapon Bond
features.description: Bond with a melee weapon, gaining magical benefits and telepathic communication.

features.name: War Magic
features.description: When taking Attack action, you can cast a cantrip using bonus action.

features.name: Eldritch Strike
features.description: After hitting with weapon attack, target has disadvantage on next save vs your spell before turn ends.
